coverage.description: P(text) concatenates, in line order, babi::split_sentences(trim_start_matches('- ', trim(line))) for nonempty lines not starting '#'. Repeated bullet prefixes are stripped; a bare '-' remains text. Sentence splits require punctuation, ASCII space and an uppercase or supported quote successor. Headings are filtered before bullet removal.
